result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but several horizontal elements are clipped at the right edge and the content appears to be in a loading state without an accompanying placeholder treatment.

issues.description: The category chip row is horizontally cut off on the right: a partial next chip is visible at the viewport edge without a clear intentional continuation treatment.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearly scrollable horizontal carousel with appropriate end padding or fade/scroll affordance, and ensure chips do not appear accidentally clipped.

issues.description: The "Fastest near you" restaurant carousel is clipped at the right edge. The third card is only partially visible, including truncated restaurant and delivery text.
issues.suggestion: Make the horizontal carousel behavior explicit and ensure card widths, gutters, and viewport padding produce an intentional peek rather than visibly truncated content.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in the fast-delivery row is visibly truncated as "Trattoria Picco...", which makes the listing label incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Increase the available card/text width, allow a suitable two-line label, or use a deliberate ellipsis style that does not look like accidental clipping.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed over the main "Tokumaru Ramen Bar" image while the full image and restaurant details are already visible, making the card look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once image content has loaded, or replace the image/details with a consistent skeleton-loading state until loading is complete.

issues.description: The second card in the "Popular right now" section is abruptly obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, leaving only part of the card visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding or account for the fixed navigation height so the final visible content can scroll fully above the navigation bar.
